CC0 standing-data exact callsign-to-route mapping. A route is retained only when the exact callsign was actually observed in the Aug 1-Sep 6 ADSBiq window.
Public search-index sitemap additionally confirms each retained physical pair remains in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 directional pairs).

Recent exact ADSBiq callsign observation (2026-08-01 through 2026-09-06) joined to the VRS standing-data callsign route and valid commercial flight-number suffix. Only routes whose operating carrier was already confirmed elsewhere are promoted to selectable route-level flight numbers.

CC0 VRS standing callsign/route dictionary flight-number reference. Standing rows can outlive current service, so these numbers remain candidates unless independently observed and paired with already-confirmed operating-carrier evidence.

Official Aena Recife arrivals board packet, SHA-256 96be1c6053197161676cc2440ce37f4a7c6bb2694ffc5278c78111ad273c4be7; arrivals observed 2026-10-03T19:27:36Z. Airport timezone America/Recife is explicit in the packet. The 121 carrier target rows preserve per-row date, displayed flight designator, local arrival clock, status and raw origin label; the board does not supply other-airport IATA codes.

Date-specific registered planned passenger stage rows from the pinned Oct 2 SIROS snapshot (27,842,178 bytes, SHA-256 2bc37f1f1098f2f87d830662c953f0443067dad168f334719c466221318941c1), captured 2026-10-02T14:23:47.646507Z. Query-date slices cover the explicit Oct 3–4 board service dates and UTC weekday flags. Registered carrier identity mappings were checked Oct 3: AZU→AD, GLO→G3, TAM→JJ. Registration rows are plan evidence only, not actual operation, a selected schedule or RTW eligibility.

Local August 2026 VRA cache, 27,597,831 bytes, SHA-256 a993dab4f8e192a473c998f7fe17703de489aaa359a4b6eb45631f68d99081d1; exact retrieval instant unavailable, verification date 2026-10-03. Joined rows require status REALIZADO and exact raw operator ICAO, flight number and ICAO airport pair. Historical movement corroboration only; passenger/cargo classification, current operation and nonstop status are not inferred from VRA.
IATA member identity reference used only for the registered operator code mapping AZU→AD; not evidence of an individual flight operator, schedule or route.
Exact current Asiana airport-name/IATA resolver including Incheon ICN, Gimpo GMP, Kobe UKB, Kansai KIX, Narita NRT, Haneda HND, Chitose CTS, Tianfu TFU, Phnom Penh KTI, Malpensa MXP and New York JFK.
Independent Japan-origin operational table. Header says 2025.08.27 while current body explicitly lists 2026/2027 windows; record chronology as shown, no corrected publication date invented.
Independent inbound ordering: East Asia origins only. Header 2025.08.27 while body explicitly lists 2026/2027; chronology discrepancy recorded, not silently corrected.
Exact airport-name/IATA resolver. Explicit new Ulaanbaatar UBN, Phnom Penh KTI and Chengdu Tianfu TFU; never substitute ULN/PNH/CTU.

Normal public form submits each TPE/TSA/KHH/RMQ international direction independently. Captured2026-09-30 UTC (Taiwan-local Oct1). Explicit SharedFlights rows excluded. Primary airline/flight fields are listed-carrier evidence, not an independent legal operating-carrier field; remain provider-listed. Clear airport arrival/departure legs only; no reverse inference. Observed flight numbers remain candidates, no dated calendar/recurrence/launch/cessation inferred. Potential fifth-freedom legs and uncertain charter cases withheld. All-airline Taiwan data layer only; alliance qualification unchanged.

Official airport-name to exact IATA dictionary. Ambiguous metropolitan identifiers and known multiple-airport cities require separate flight-specific official corroboration; no expansion to coterminals.

Official international departure iframe linked from en.ulaanbaatar-airport.mn/international-flights. Complete 68-line timetable inspected; current intervals compared; ICAO identifiers retained in evidence, no fabricated IATA flightNumbers.
UBN mapping from airline guide; destination PEK IST NRT facility mappings cross checked against already archived ANA/JAL child guides.

Undated official route page: positive direct-flight field and explicit route prose; exact IATA table. Legal operating entity and current dated operation unconfirmed. Frequencies, fares, times and first/last flight numbers intentionally excluded.

Approved Summer Schedule Airport Movement Report; explicit Operator Air India Ltd., operator code AIC; physical arrival-from/departure-to columns verified by original PDF coordinates. Approved schedule validity not proof of dispatch or route inauguration. Slash endpoints and AI4xxx held.
84 pages; all 5251 extracted source lines captured; exact station IATA, aircraft, times and row effective dates. Only adjacent legs used.
70page full official PDF effectiveJuly1-Oct24, distinct ANA vsAKX/partner operatingcolumn. Exact continuous date intervals parsed, not same-dayflight guarantee.
Public current ANA origin picker explicitly maps all61 Japanese schedule airportlabels to IATA; sourcev102 DOM preserved, OSAexcluded.

2026-Q2 worldwide ADS-B-derived passenger-flight observations. GCMP retains only callsign-validated directional routes with at least two known non-cargo passenger-config observations; this is recent-operation evidence, not a September timetable.

CC0 Virtual Radar Server standing-data callsign-to-route mapping at the pinned commit. Used only to corroborate the observed carrier/route identity; standing-data alone is not treated as an active timetable.

Public search-index route sitemap confirmed that each retained physical airport pair remained present in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 indexed directional pairs). It does not establish the operating carrier by itself.
